question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Let's double-check by looking at the top customers more carefully
-- and verify customer 487 indeed has the highest average monthly change
WITH monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
    SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    monthly_total,
    LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_monthly_total
  FROM monthly_totals
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    monthly_total - prev_monthly_total as change
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    AVG(change) as avg_monthly_change
  FROM changes
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
  ac.customer_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
